criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frame 1 passes the place-and-hour test, 2, 3 and 9 believable interiors, frame 7 strongest. Box-extruded skyline, matching dome trees, frame 5's bars are slabs on the ground, frame 6 a blurred close-up with a dead band and toy red-ball eyes, frame 4 a chart pinned to a wall.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero in one material, two worlds sharing the light, the room bookends. Three sky-to-room cuts, the hero jumps in scale to a thumb-sized prop on 2 and 9, frame 8 nearly repeats frame 1.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every figure and drawn count traces, sources primary, every cited id in the first comment. The caption gives the hospital the researchers' finding, frame 7 draws climbing heights c18 and c19 do not describe, only abstracts read.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, how and what to do. Eligibility stays at 'underserved' with c38 unused, the Texas focus (c27, c47) is not said.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 6 to 7 a real turn, 9 an action. Frame 5 breaks chronology and stalls a lay reader.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain, specific, unhyped, house rules hold. Generic kickers, little Texas register, frame 5's dek reads like an abstract.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh object and instrument. Fourth Houston hospital deck in the window, opening and carried-object structure repeat.

one_sentence_fix: Say plainly what 98 and 57 measure or fold frame 5 into frame 3, and tell a family concretely whether they qualify with c38 and c47.
